comments.author: notsakuzyo
comments.body_html:
love the mod! I actually want to suggest turning a bug into an official feature.

Like @vinmel mentioned in the comments, using a “continuous R” keybind (similar to Ready or Not) creates this behaviour

Hold R: Starts the mag check (with animation slow-down disabled).

Release R immediately: Triggers a reload.

Keep holding R until the mag is back in: Cancels the reload.

I absolutely love playing this way, but since it’s just a bug right now, it’s inconsistent. It works sometimes on the primary weapon, but fails entirely on secondary and second primary slots.

Is there any chance you could officially implement this
